title: Time Needed to Inform All Employees
statement:
A company has `n` employees numbered `0` to `n - 1`. Exactly one of them, `headID`, is the head and has no manager; every other employee `i` has exactly one direct manager `manager[i]` (for the head, `manager[headID] = -1`). The reporting structure forms a tree rooted at the head.

The head has some urgent news. It spreads like this: an employee who knows the news spends `informTime[i]` minutes informing **all** of their direct subordinates at once, and those subordinates then know the news at the same moment (after those `informTime[i]` minutes). Subordinates then start informing their own subordinates, and so on. An employee with no subordinates has `informTime[i] = 0`.

The head knows the news at minute `0`. Print the number of minutes until every employee knows it.
inputFormat:
The first line contains two integers `n` and `headID`.
The second line contains `n` integers `manager[0], ..., manager[n-1]`.
The third line contains `n` integers `informTime[0], ..., informTime[n-1]`.
outputFormat: Print one integer: the number of minutes needed for the news to reach everyone.
constraints: 0 ≤ headID < n, manager[headID] = -1, and the structure is a valid tree
0 ≤ informTime[i] ≤ 10^4, and informTime[i] = 0 if employee i has no subordinates
No employee is more than 5000 levels below the head (so recursive solutions fit in the call stack)

examples.explanation: Employee 0 informs employees 1 and 2 at minute 3. Employee 1 informs 3 and 4 at minute 3 + 2 = 5. Employee 2 informs 5 and 6 at minute 3 + 5 = 8. The last person learns it at minute 8.
It is a chain 3 -> 0 -> 1 -> 2. Employee 0 learns at minute 7, employee 1 at 7 + 4 = 11, employee 2 at 11 + 2 = 13.
The head is the only employee, so nobody needs to be informed.

hints: The time at which an employee learns the news is the sum of informTime over all of their managers up the chain to the head.
So the answer is the largest such sum over all employees. Build a children list from manager[] and traverse from the head with DFS or BFS, carrying the accumulated time.
Alternatively, walk up from each employee and memoize the total time per employee so no chain is walked twice.
